name: CropInsuranceLossClaim
tagline: Crop loss claims from notice of loss to indemnity payment – per insured unit, in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete crop insurance loss claim app for growers, crop insurance agencies and adjusting teams: report hail, frost, drought or flood losses per insured unit, file the notice of loss inside the notice window, schedule the adjuster, record the appraisal, collect the claim documents, sign the proof of loss and follow approval and payment – with yield, revenue and named-peril hail indemnity estimates, affected-vs-insured acre checks and large-loss review. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Yield, revenue and named-peril hail indemnity estimates
Affected vs insured acres check per unit
Indemnity payment split pro rata per claim
19 quick filters, grouping, CSV export, bulk add to claim
Undo, history notes, read-only and disabled states
